result.answer:
## You're Eligible — Here's the Full Picture

**Eligibility: YES.** Tanaka Bakery qualifies for Kaiju Damage Compensation. Verified structural damage to a commercial property in Zone 4, reported within the 90-day claim window (21 days since incident), meets the core eligibility rule:
> *"Claims require verified structural damage to a property in zones 3, 4 or 5."* — [/claims/eligibility/](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/claims/eligibility/#zone)

### Extra Support You Qualify For

1. **Assessment fee waived** — Normally ¥12,000, but waived because you have two approved claims from separate incidents in the last 12 months.
   > *"Claimants with two or more approved claims from separate incidents within any rolling 12-month period are exempt from the ¥12,000 assessment fee."* — [/claims/faq/](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/claims/faq/#fee-waivers)

2. **Hardship supplement** — Your household income (¥3,600,000) is under the ¥4,000,000 threshold.
   > *"Households with annual income below ¥4,000,000 receive a hardship supplement."* — [/claims/eligibility/](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/claims/eligibility/#hardship)

3. **Business-interruption compensation** — Available since Tanaka Bakery is a commercial property.
   > *"Compensation covers business interruption for commercial properties."* — [/claims/damage-compensation/](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/claims/damage-compensation/#covered)

*(No insurer payout was received, so that isn't a disqualifying factor — and it means you won't need an insurance settlement letter.)*

### Documents You Need to Bring

Because of the grants above (hardship supplement + business interruption), your document list is longer than the baseline requirement:

| Document | Why it's needed |
|---|---|
| **Incident report receipt** | Must have been filed within 72 hours of the incident |
| **Damage survey** | Photographs + itemised loss schedule of the shopfront and rear wall damage |
| **Proof of ownership or tenancy** | For Tanaka Bakery |
| **Household income certificate** | Required to claim the hardship supplement |
| **Business registration certificate** | Required for the business-interruption claim |

*(Insurance settlement letter is not required, since no payout was received.)*

### Practical Details
- **Claim deadline:** 90 days from the incident (you're well within this at 21 days)
- **Assessment fee:** ¥12,000, but **waived** for you as a repeat claimant; would also be refunded in full on awards above ¥1,000,000 if it weren't already waived
- **Processing time:** ~15 business days to an assessor visit, up to 45 days for full determination

Source: [/claims/damage-compensation/](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/claims/damage-compensation/) and [/claims/how-to-file/](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/claims/how-to-file/)
